key.name: ha-url
key.description: The URL of your Home Assistant instance (include http:// or https://)

key.name: ha-token
key.description: Long-lived access token from Home Assistant for API authentication

key.name: display-entities
key.description: List of entity IDs to display in the panel

key.name: automations

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Interval in seconds to refresh entity states
